source: Conservative approximation of public organic CTR-by-position studies of desktop and mobile Google results (Advanced Web Ranking CTR study, Backlinko 2019 "We analyzed 5 million Google search results", Sistrix 2020). Values are rounded down so that only clearly low CTRs are flagged; positions 11-20 are extrapolated from page-two figures. Fractional positions are interpolated linearly; positions after the last entry use the last value. A heuristic: real CTR depends on SERP features, brand and intent.
